The "[[Figrin D'an]] Killer"...This card is one of the best counters to the Rebel's sure fire Force Regeneration Strategy using [[Figrin D'an]]. Played in combination with [[U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio){{!}}U-3PO]], and you can move an infected droid wherever the Rebels try to run. Since no Rebel would dare leave [[Figrin D'an]] alone at a site, your sure to Trap multiple Rebel characters in the explosion. Should they dare use Figrin D'ans Force Regeneration ability, they risk five destiny draws, each with the potential of setting off the explosion. A simple two card combo that is extremely effective.

A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (6 January 2026). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-D-programtrap-PC-Errata-2026-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Program Trap (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (17 August 2019): The game text changes: “R2-D2 and C-3PO),” becomes “C-3PO or R2-D2),”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of the bronze disc.

The whole 2019 disc card image and the whole 2026 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
